title: Rumoured LEGO Star Wars cinema set has a long line of LEGO movie theatres before it
summary: Chatter about a possible LEGO Star Wars cinema set for 2027 has us looking back at the LEGO cinemas that have already graced our shelves, from 2008's Town Plan to the beloved Palace Cinema modular.
bodyMarkdown:
## What happened
Brick Fanatics has rounded up LEGO's cinema-building history following **rumours** (unconfirmed) of a new LEGO Star Wars cinema set, said to be numbered 75659 and dubbed a 'Movie Theatre'. According to these rumours, it would be an 18+ set retailing at $199.99 in the US and arriving on 1 April 2027 — but none of this has been officially confirmed by LEGO, so treat it as speculation for now.

If it does happen, it wouldn't be LEGO's first trip to the pictures. The first full LEGO cinema build appeared in **2008's 10184 Town Plan**, a 1,981-piece anniversary set marking 50 years of the LEGO brick, complete with a marquee, ticket booth, snack counter and a full screen showing a western.

The most famous LEGO cinema followed in **2013 with 10232 Palace Cinema**, a 2,196-piece modular building inspired by Hollywood's Chinese Theatre. It featured a four-walled interior with room for six minifigures at the screen, plus posters for in-universe films — and US buyers in September 2013 even got a bonus poster referencing The LEGO Movie.

A smaller entry came in **2014 with 40180 Bricktober Theater**, a 164-piece Toys 'R' Us giveaway set continuing the cinema theme on a much smaller scale.

## Why it matters
LEGO cinema builds have a strong pedigree among modular and city fans, so a potential Star Wars-themed entry — sitting alongside multi-theme sets like Friends, Batman and Icons — would be a notable addition if confirmed. For UK collectors and display builders, it's worth keeping an eye on official announcements before getting too invested in the rumoured details.

## What to watch next
No official confirmation exists yet for 75659. Watch for LEGO's own announcements or further credible leaks before treating the price, date, or age rating as fact.
riskNotes: The Star Wars 'Movie Theatre' set number, price and release date are all rumoured and unconfirmed by LEGO — verify before treating as fact. title: LEGO Icons 11382 Hubble Space Telescope: Brick Fanatics review round-up

bodyMarkdown:
## What happened
Brick Fanatics has published its review of LEGO Icons 11382 Hubble Space Telescope, scoring it 8/10 overall. The 1,252-piece set is described as the first true minifigure-scale, standalone Hubble model, following earlier cameos of the telescope in sets like 21312 Women of NASA and 10283 NASA Space Shuttle Discovery.

According to the review, the set recreates an astronaut carrying out a spacewalk repair on the telescope, similar in style to 10266 NASA Apollo 11 Lunar Lander. It includes one exclusive astronaut minifigure with new printing, used to help convey the telescope's real-world scale. The reviewer notes that many interior details aren't visible once built, and that the building experience can feel fragile at times.

Brick Fanatics' rating breakdown gives the set 9/10 for design, 8/10 for value, 8/10 for minifigures, and 7/10 for the build itself. The review also suggests a second minifigure - NASA's first chief astronomer Nancy Grace Roman, nicknamed the 'Mother of Hubble' - would have been a welcome addition, especially as her only previous minifigure appearance was in 21312 Women of NASA nearly a decade ago.

## Why it matters
Space-themed LEGO sets have a strong following among collectors and display builders, and a dedicated Hubble model has been a long time coming given the telescope's cultural and scientific significance. For fans of NASA collaborations and minifigure-scale builds, this review offers a useful first-hand look at what to expect before buying.
